examples.question: Read the fable. A town mouse visited his country cousin and laughed at the plain food. In the city, they ate fine food but were chased by cats. The country mouse went home happily. What is the theme (lesson) of this fable?
examples.answer: A simple, safe life is better than a rich, fearful one.
choices: Kindness and gentleness work better than force.
Slow and steady wins the race.
People will not believe someone who often lies.
